text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: INC-8421 - gpu.oom on node infer-west2a-27. Auto-retries failing. Severity: P1.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page sent to @Sam W (oncall). Link: https://pd.example/INC-8421

Sam W: ack - I'm on it. pinging @Lee K for metrics and @Maria G for customer impact.

Lee K: looking at the node now. KV cache evictions spiking, memory climbs to ~98% then OOMs. Multiple containers restarting.

Lee K: `nvidia-smi` snapshot: 
```
| GPU 0 | TeslaA100 | 40536MiB / 40536MiB | Util 97% |
| Processes: python(4) - gpt-medium-quant
```

Maria G: customer ScribeAnalytics uses pool dedicated-east-gpu (routed via infer-west2a). Notified support, opening customer ticket. Potentially degraded for some requests.

Sam W: attempting mitigations - plan: 1) redirect traffic for ScribeAnalytics to fallback model (gpt-small) 2) reduce prefetch/prefill limits for pool 3) drain node if unstable. Starting step 1 now.

Lee K: pushed temporary throttle: `prefetch_limit=0.4` for pool infer-west2a-27 via runtime config. Monitoring metrics.

Sam W: initiated routing change at +90s - Canary to gpt-small for 10% of sessions for ScribeAnalytics; CLI: `redwoodctl routes shift --customer=scribe --to=gpt-small --pct=10`

Maria G: support: ~12% of ScribeAnalytics requests returned 502 between 3387650015-3387650030, mostly long-generation jobs. Support sent pre-baked message to customer.

Lee K: eviction rate down after throttle. Node still shows KV churn but no new OOMs for last 60s. Spikes previously correlated with larger sequence lengths.

Sam W: preparing drain if OOMs recur. Command ready: `kubectl drain infer-west2a-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` - will only do if we see 2 more OOMs in 5m.

Maria G: logging incident impact to Scribe ticket and ops. ETA for wider rollback: monitoring for 10 mins then decide.

Sam W: ack in PD and updated incident with mitigation steps. Will hand off to rotation if stable. Keeping channel updated. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: INC-8421 acknowledged by Sam W.

Lee K: marking current status: mitigated (traffic throttled + fallback). No active OOMs in last 3m. Will keep watch and collect traces for postmortem.

Sam W: moving this thread to eng-oncall for continued monitoring and postmortem follow-up. Handoff at 3387650300.

Maria G: added customer follow-up note and asked CS to offer extra credits for impact window.

Sam W: thanks team. I'll write up a short timeline and file a PM for root cause.
